etymology.historical_story: Mitchell does not have one origin shared by every family. English and Scottish branches can derive from medieval spoken forms of Michael, while others began as a nickname meaning big, from Middle English michel and related forms. Some Irish families adopted it as an equivalent of Mulvihill. A person's surname alone cannot establish which history applies. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=mitchell)
